```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  filter(week == max(week)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(week == 20) |>
  summarize(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank > 50)
  )

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarize(
    first_week = min(week),
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    weeks_to_number_one = if_else(
      best_rank == 1,
      first_week_at_best - first_week + 1L,
      NA_integer_
    )
  )

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_min(weeks_to_number_one, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = paste0("Fastest to #1: ", artist, " - ", track)),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_max(weeks_to_number_one, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = paste0("Slowest to #1: ", artist, " - ", track)),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
    slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = paste0("Longest top-10 run: ", artist, " - ", track))
)

notable_songs |>
  select(
    notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank,
    first_week_at_best, weeks_on_chart, weeks_to_number_one
  ) |>
  print(width = Inf)

top_10_songs <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(
    song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |> select(artist, track, notable),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  mutate(notable = replace_na(notable, "Other top-10 songs"))

ggplot(
  top_10_songs,
  aes(
    x = week,
    y = rank,
    group = interaction(artist, track),
    color = notable
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other top-10 songs" = "gray75",
      "Fastest to #1: Madonna - Music" = "#0072B2",
      "Slowest to #1: Lonestar - Amazed" = "#D55E00",
      "Longest top-10 run: Creed - Higher" = "#009E73"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Billboard ranking",
    color = "Song"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "ranking"
  ) |>
  group_by(week) |>
  summarize(
    present = sum(!is.na(ranking)),
    missing = sum(is.na(ranking))
  )
```
